register.labelZh: GET OFF 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: GET OFF Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: get off 可以表示開始旅程,也可以表示離開巴士、火車、飛機或船。；Get off my land 和 Get off me 可以要求某人離開某處,或停止碰着另一個人。；get off on 表示強烈興奮;get off with somebody 則描述浪漫或性接觸。；完整情境能幫助你分辨 get off after breakfast、get off the bus、get off my land 和 get off me。
register.summaryEn: Get off can show that you are beginning a journey or leaving a bus, train, plane or boat. Expressions such as Get off my land and Get off me tell someone to leave a place or stop touching another person. Get off on describes strong excitement, while get off with somebody describes romantic or sexual involvement. The full situation helps you distinguish get off after breakfast, get off the bus, get off my land and get off me.
